text:
Maya Rao: Quick heads up — prepping the Crestline EBR next week. Need two quick things for the deck: 1) a concise health + renewal-risk snapshot for slide 3, 2) who owns the short live demo (feature walkthrough). Dropping the draft deck here: https://redwood-cloud.s3/crestline/ebr-draft-v1.pptx

Jon Peters: I can take the demo if Priya is tied up. 11:30am PT works for a 20m dry run tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: I want to highlight enablement gaps (onboarding -> product adoption) — happy to co-run the demo with Jon and cover the enablement slides. Alex, can you pull the latest adoption/perf numbers for the adoption slide?

Alex Kim: Yep — will pull 30-day latency and error-rate slices from telemetry and add a small chart to the perf slide. Need the sequence length and qps target you expect for the demo.

Maya Rao: Demo target = 20 concurrent sessions, avg seq len ~512. Renewal signal status: Amber (score down 0.8 -> 0.6 over last 90d). Planning a compact heatmap on slide 3 and a short renewal ask: exec intro + pricing pathways.

onboarding-bot: New onboarding survey ingested (2026-03-20): NPS 7.4, top request: more interactive onboarding templates. Filed ticket CS-1129.

Jon Peters: Pasting recent onboarding feedback for slide notes — low friction for SSO + clearer handoff docs. I'll paste into notes:
- Need SSO walkthrough with screenshots
- Request example prompts + guardrails
- Clarify dedicated vs hosted capacity benefits

Priya Nair: I'll synthesize that into a 2-slide enablement plan (owners + timeline). Quick ask: who can own the SSO walkthrough writeup? @Alex Kim?

Alex Kim: I can own the SSO writeup. ETA: EOD Friday. Will attach the perf CSV to the deck.

Maya Rao: Dry-run plan: 11:30am PT tomorrow in the #customer-success huddle. Slide owners: Maya (exec summary + renewal ask), Alex (perf + SSO writeup pointer), Priya (enablement plan + adoption milestones), Jon (commercial ask + feedback capture). I'll send the calendar invite and a link to the slide timestamp we should rehearse.

Jon Peters: I'll prepare the renewal options slide (three options: 6mo pilot, 12mo committed, enterprise bundle) with a topline exec ask. I'll also DM the AE lead to request a 3-minute intro at the review.

Priya Nair: Added a post-EBR checklist into the deck notes and created GH issue CS-4521 to track follow-ups. I'll add owners for each line item.

Maya Rao: Final action list (quick):
- Alex: SSO walkthrough doc + perf chart (EOD Fri)
- Priya: Enablement 2-slide plan + assign owners (before dry-run)
- Jon: Renewal options slide + request exec intro (before dry-run)
- Maya: Finalize heatmap + update risk bullets (before dry-run)

Maya Rao: Drop blockers here. If no objections I'll lock the deck 2 hours before the dry-run. :lock:
